tool_args.rationale: Both off-baseline gradients were measured at different drive values, so the data do not show how the gradient response changes with drive. Two smooth laws fit the paid data equally well yet disagree by about 0.90 at a combination of already sampled input levels, versus a tolerance of 0.045. Acquire the additional batch before committing to either law.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Fits all seven rows with RMSE below 0.001, but the two off-baseline gradient measurements do not distinguish it from multiplicative inhibition.
Fits equally well but predicts about 2.23 instead of 3.14 at u_now=0.5 and s_grad=0.2, with the other inputs held at pilot values.
The existing branch measurements establish sink inhibition, but no repeat is specified to provide new drive–gradient combinations.
